reviews.title: Ramadan starts, prayer times stop
reviews.text:
I have been a legacy user for years and use the widget to track time. Since the latest update I have not been able to get back my premium lifetime membership (there is no option to restore purchase). In a rush to sweep up more cash through ads, the developers have knowingly or carelessly revoked access from users who had purchased the app before (like me, before the extortionate prices). 

Speaking of which, charging £99.99 for lifetime membership for what the majority of users use for prayer times is absolutely pure greed. Causing issues for Muslims by releasing an update that breaks the app and prevents legacy premium users from using the features they paid for is also annoying. Not happy with this app and will be looking for something new and seeking a charge back for whatever I spent on the app all those years ago (not that the developers care, since I won’t accidentally click ads for them to make extra $$$).
